DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの明細についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Aling transaksiyon sa statement ang itatanong?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この会社名を知りません。使った覚えがないので、不正な引き落としだと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らない明細名義を見つけ不正と疑ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi ko kilala ang kompanyang ito. Wala akong maalalang gamit kaya inisip kong ilegal na kaltas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi kilala ang pangalan sa statement at pinaghinalaang pandaraya. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認しましょう。金額と日付に、心当たりのある支払いはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Suriin natin. May bayad kayong naaalala sa petsa at halaga?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その日は家具を買いました。金額は近いですが、店の名前とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同日の買い物と近い金額の心当たりを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Bumili ako ng muwebles noon. Malapit ang halaga pero iba sa pangalan ng tindahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang bili sa parehong araw at malapit na halaga. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 販売店と明細上の名義が異なる場合もあります。ただし、同じ取引とはまだ断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Maaaring magkaiba ang pangalan ng nagbenta at statement. Pero hindi pa matitiyak na parehong transaksiyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レシートを見て照合したいです。名前が違うだけで、不正だと決めつけないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名義違いだけで断定せずレシート照合を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Gusto kong itugma sa resibo. Hindi ko agad ituturing na pandaraya dahil sa pangalan lang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipatugma ang resibo nang hindi agad humuhusga sa pangalan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、レシートや利用記録をご用意ください。銀行で確認できる範囲もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Ihanda ang resibo at tala ng gamit. Sasabihin din ang kayang suriin ng bangko.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし金額や日付が合わず心当たりがなければ、その結果も伝えて相談を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 照合が合わない場合も事実を伝えて相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kung hindi tugma ang halaga o petsa at hindi ko maalala, sasabihin ko rin at itutuloy ang konsultasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang sabihin ang resulta at katotohanan kahit hindi tugma. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。今は不明な取引として確認し、対応が必要かを担当者がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pakiusap. Susuriin muna bilang hindi kilalang transaksiyon; sasabihin ng kawani kung kailangan ng aksiyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず家具のレシートと明細を比べ、違う点を整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 比較する資料と相違点を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Ihahambing ko muna ang resibo ng muwebles sa statement at aayusin ang pagkakaiba.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ayusin ang dokumento at pagkakaiba ng paghahambing. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認する項目をお伝えし、明細の照会担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Ipapaliwanag ang titingnan at ipapasa sa kawani ng pagtatanong sa statement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお会計は終わりました。商品をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tapos na ang bayad. Kunin ang binili.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族はまだ買い物中なので、この冷凍食品を冷凍庫に戻して待ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族を待つ間の冷凍保管を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Namimili pa ang pamilya. Maaari bang ibalik ang frozen food na ito sa freezer at itago habang naghihintay?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humiling ng frozen storage habang naghihintay ng pamilya. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入後の商品を売場の冷凍庫へ戻すことはできません。預かり対応も確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi maibabalik ang nabili sa freezer ng bentahan. Kailangan ding suriin kung maitatabi namin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会計した物なら好きな時まで預けられると思っていました。自分では戻しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入後の保管を当然と思ったことを訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko puwedeng iwan ang nabayaran hanggang gusto ko. Hindi ko ibabalik nang sarili.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itama ang pag-aakalang awtomatiko ang pag-iimbak matapos bumili. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では、購入後の冷凍保管サービスはありません。ご家族と合流の予定を調整できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Walang frozen storage matapos bumili sa sitwasyong ito. Maaayos ba ang pagkikita ninyo ng pamilya?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、家族に会計が終わったと連絡します。先に帰るか、早めに来てもらうか相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保管不可を受け家族と合流を調整すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Oo. Sasabihin kong tapos na ang bayad at pag-usapan kung uuwi muna ako o papupuntahin sila nang maaga.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing aayusin ang pagkikita dahil hindi maitatabi. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保冷用品の販売もあります。必要であれば表示を確認して選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: May binebentang gamit na pampalamig. Kung kailangan, suriin ang label bago pumili.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 保冷袋は買いますが、それで長く置いてよいと決めつけず、家までの時間も考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保冷袋の効果だけに頼らず移動時間も考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Bibili ako ng insulated bag, pero hindi iisiping puwedeng iwan nang matagal; isasaalang-alang din ang oras pauwi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Isipin ang biyahe at hindi epekto lang ng bag. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。ご家族への連絡を済ませ、持ち帰る方法を決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sige. Kontakin ang pamilya at magpasya sa pag-uwi ng pagkain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族はあと五分で来るそうです。保冷袋に入れ、合流したら寄り道せず持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合流時刻と寄り道しない持ち帰り計画を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Darating sila sa limang minuto. Ilalagay sa insulated bag at pagkakita ay diretso uuwi nang hindi dadaan sa iba.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tukuyin ang oras at planong diretso uuwi. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。保冷袋の売場をご案内します。購入した食品はご自身でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Ituturo ko ang insulated bags. Kayo ang humawak ng biniling pagkain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写真の撮影についてのご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家族写真の位置を覚えるため、この木にテープを貼ってもいいですか。終わったら取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 撮影位置の目印として木へのテープ貼りを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Maaari bang lagyan ng tape ang punong ito para maalala ang puwesto ng family photo? Tatanggalin ko pagkatapos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang tape sa puno bilang marka ng puwesto. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取る予定でも、木に貼ってよいとは限りません。この場面では木への貼り付けはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kahit tatanggalin, hindi ibig sabihing pinapayagan. Bawal magdikit sa puno sa sitwasyong ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。跡が残らないつもりでしたが、貼らずに位置を覚える方法を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 剥がす予定でも許可とはならないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Balak kong walang bakas, pero mag-iisip ng walang ididikit na paraan ng pag-alala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Unawaing ang pagtatanggal sa huli ay hindi pahintulot. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 持ち物を置く場合も、通路をふさがず、放置しないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kung maglalapag ng gamit, huwag humarang o iwan nang walang bantay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: かばんを目印にしても、そのまま離れません。木とベンチの位置を写真で記録するだけでもよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 放置物を使わず景色を記録する方法を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kahit bag ang palatandaan, hindi ko iiwan. Maaari rin sigurong itala sa larawan ang puno at bangko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Imungkahing itala ang tanawin nang walang iniiwang gamit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、設備や通路を変えない方法を選んでください。他の人が写ることにも気をつけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Pumili ng hindi binabago ang pasilidad o daanan. Ingatan din ang ibang taong makukunan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通る人がいる時は撮影を待ちます。写り込んだ人を、勝手に家族写真として公開しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行者を待ち写り込みの公開も避けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Maghihintay ako kapag may dumaraan. Hindi ko ilalathala bilang family photo ang ibang taong kasama nang walang pahintulot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing maghihintay sa dumaraan at iiwasan ang paglalathala ng ibang taong kasama. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。撮影後は持ち物を確認し、ごみなども残さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pakiusap. Tingnan ang gamit pagkatapos at walang iwang basura.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。テープは使わず、景色を目印にして、撮影後に持ち物を全部持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: テープを使わず持ち物を全て撤去すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Oo. Tanawin ang gagawing marka nang walang tape at iuuwi lahat ng gamit pagkatapos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang walang tape at alisin lahat ng gamit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その方法で周囲の利用者と譲り合って撮影してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Sa paraang iyon, magbigayan sa ibang gumagamit habang kumukuha.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機の操作でお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。音声が聞き取れず、同じボタンを二回押したかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 聞き取れない音声と重複操作の可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Hindi ko narinig nang malinaw at baka dalawang beses napindot ang parehong buton.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi narinig at posibleng dobleng pindot. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず画面をそのままにしてください。お金やカードは入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Iwan muna ang screen. May naipasok na pera o kard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ入れていません。画面には人数が二人と出ますが、買うのは一人分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未入金と画面の誤った人数を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Wala pa. Dalawang tao ang nasa screen, pero para sa isa ang bibilhin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakitang wala pang bayad at maling dami ang screen. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人数を戻せます。画面の文字で確認しながら操作しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Maibabalik ang dami. Gamitin habang tinitingnan ang teksto sa screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。音だけで判断せず、人数が一人になった表示を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 音声でなく一人の表示を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakiusap. Gusto kong makita ang isang tao sa halip na umasa lang sa tunog.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hilinging tingnan ang isa sa screen at hindi boses. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一人になりました。次に行き先を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Isa na. Susunod, tingnan ang destinasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 港駅です。画面の港駅と金額を確認してからお金を入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 行き先と金額を見て支払いへ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Minato Station. Titingnan ang Minato at halaga bago magpasok ng pera.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tingnan ang destinasyon at halaga bago magbayad. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。券が出るまで何度も購入ボタンを押さず、表示をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo. Huwag paulit-ulit pindutin ang bili habang hinihintay ang tiket; hintayin ang screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。一回ずつ表示を見て進め、券とお釣りが出たか最後に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連打せず発券と釣銭を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Bawat hakbang titingnan at sa huli titiyaking lumabas ang tiket at sukli.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi sunod-sunod pipindot at titingnan ang tiket at sukli. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。操作が分からなくなったら、その画面のままお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Kapag nalito, iwan ang screen at tawagin kami.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明に載せる方は、世帯全員ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Buong sambahayan ang ilalagay sa sertipiko?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族と住んでいるので、全員を選べばいいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族同居から全員分を選ぼうとした理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kasama ko ang pamilya sa bahay kaya akala ko lahat ang pipiliin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag kung bakit napiling lahat dahil kasama ang pamilya. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先は、誰の情報を求めていますか。案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kaninong impormasyon ang hinihingi ng tatanggap? May gabay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内には申請者本人と書いてあります。家族の情報も必要とはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先が本人分だけを求める案内を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Aplikante lang ang nasa gabay. Hindi sinasabing kailangan din ang pamilya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang gabay na sarili lang ang kailangan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 全員分と本人分は別です。本人分を希望するか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Magkaiba ang lahat at sarili. Kumpirmahin kung sarili lang ang gusto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人分を希望します。ただ、案内にない項目を全部載せる必要があるかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人分に絞り記載項目も相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sarili lang. Pero gusto ko ring malaman kung kailangan lahat ng detalyeng wala sa gabay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Limitahan sa sarili at itanong din ang detalye. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記載する項目も、提出先の要件に合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Susuriin din ang detalye ayon sa hinihingi ng tatanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では余分な項目を自分で選ぶ前に、提出先へ必要な記載を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不要項目を選ぶ前に提出先へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Bago sariling pumili ng sobra, tatanungin ko ang tatanggap kung ano ang kailangan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing magtatanong sa tatanggap bago pumili ng hindi kailangan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は発行を確定せず、確認内容を整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sige. Maaari nating ayusin ang itatanong ngayon nang hindi muna ilalabas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。対象は自分だけ、記載項目は確認待ちと分けてメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定した対象と未確定の記載内容を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap. Itatala kong hiwalay na sarili lang ang paksa at naghihintay ang detalye ng kumpirmasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ayusin ang tiyak na paksa at hindi pa tiyak na detalye. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。発行は保留し、確認後に申請できるようご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Ipaghihintay ang paglabas at gagabay upang makapag-apply matapos makumpirma.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 来院の受付はお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tapos na ang reception ng pagbisita?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。以前使った裏口へ来ましたが、閉まっていて、予約に遅れそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 以前の閉鎖入口へ来て未受付だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi pa. Nasa dating likurang pasukan ako, pero sarado at baka mahuli sa appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nasa dating saradong entrada at hindi pa narehistro. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の案内の地図はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: May mapa ba ng kasalukuyang gabay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。地図では正面側に印があります。以前の入口と同じだと思って見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今回の地図を見落としたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oo. Nasa harap ang marka. Akala ko dating pasukan at hindi ko tiningnan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hindi napansin ang kasalukuyang mapa. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在使える入口を係員がご案内します。閉鎖した入口から入ろうとしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ituturo ng kawani ang bukas na entrada. Huwag subukang pumasok sa sarado.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。案内された入口へ移ります。予約担当には、建物に着いたが未受付と伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正しい入口へ移り到着済みと受付未済を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Lilipat sa itinuro. Sabihin sa kawani ng appointment na nasa gusali na pero hindi pa sa reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Lumipat sa tamang entrada at ihiwalay ang pagdating sa registration. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。建物への到着と診療受付は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Hiwalay ang pagdating sa gusali at medikal na pagtanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。遅れた分を取り戻そうと診察室へ直接行かず、先に受付します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診察室へ直行せず受付を先にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Salamat. Hindi didiretso sa silid para bumawi sa pagkaantala; magpaparehistro muna.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Unahin ang reception at hindi diretso sa silid ng pagsusuri. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 係員が入口と受付場所を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Gagabayan ng kawani ang entrada at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。新しい地図を見ながら移動し、予約の扱いは受付で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現行地図で移動し予約の扱いを受付で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap. Gagamitin ang bagong mapa at sa reception tatanungin ang appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Lumipat gamit ang bagong mapa at alamin sa reception ang appointment. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。入口で迷った経緯を受付へ引き継ぎ、係員がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Ipapasa namin ang pagkalito sa entrada at gagabayan kayo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: バッグについて、何があったか教えてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 店を出た時にバッグがありませんでした。盗まれたと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: バッグがなく盗難と思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Wala ang bag paglabas ng tindahan. Akala ko ninakaw kaya pumunta rito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nawala ang bag at inakalang ninakaw. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持ち去る人を見たのでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。入店時に店員へ預けたかもしれません。預けた記憶もまだはっきりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持ち去りは見ておらず預けた可能性を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi. Baka iniwan ko sa kawani pagpasok. Hindi pa rin malinaw ang alaala ng pag-iwan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi nakitang kinuha at posibleng iniwan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確かなことと未確認のことを分けましょう。店には連絡しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ihiwalay ang tiyak sa hindi pa alam. Nakontak na ang tindahan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。店の控えらしい札がポケットにあるので、まずその店へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 控えらしい札があり店へ未連絡だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi pa. May tag sa bulsa na mukhang resibo ng tindahan, kaya gusto kong magtanong muna roon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing may mukhang resibo at hindi pa nakontak ang tindahan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 店名と札の内容を確認して連絡してください。見つからなければ経過を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tingnan ang pangalan at tag, saka tumawag. Kung hindi makita, pakikinggan ang nangyari.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。店にあると断定もせず、預かり品に該当するか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店での保管も断定せず確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Hindi ko rin ititiyak na nandoon; itatanong kung kabilang sa iniwang gamit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing magtatanong nang hindi tinitiyak na nasa tindahan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。確認した結果と、最後にバッグを持っていた場所を整理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo. Ayusin ang resulta at huling lugar na hawak ang bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認前は盗難を見たとは言わず、バッグがないことと預けた可能性を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確かな事実と未確認の経緯を分けて報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Bago makumpirma hindi sasabihing nakita kong ninakaw, kundi walang bag at posibleng iniwan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Iulat nang hiwalay ang tiyak at hindi pa kumpirmadong nangyari. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。未確認の経緯として受け止め、店への確認結果に応じてご相談を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Ituturing na hindi pa kumpirmado at itutuloy ayon sa sagot ng tindahan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒で送るご予定ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ここに料金の表示があるので、切手はもう貼られていると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 印刷された料金表示を切手と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. May nakaimprentang bayad, kaya akala ko may selyo na.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na inakalang selyo ang limbag na bayad. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それは以前の発送用の印刷です。新しい手紙の切手とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Iyan ay para sa dating pagpapadala, hindi selyo para sa bagong sulat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この封筒を再利用しても、前の表示で料金を払ったことにはならないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒再利用でも新料金は別だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kaya kahit gamitin muli ang sobre, hindi ibig sabihing bayad na ito sa lumang marka.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Kumpirmahing may hiwalay na bagong bayad kahit gamitin muli. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。古い宛先や表示も紛らわしいので確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Oo. Kailangang tingnan ang lumang address at marka dahil nakalilito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の新しい宛先は裏に書きましたが、表に古い宛先が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表裏に古い宛先と新宛先が残ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Bagong destinasyon sa likod, pero lumang address sa harap pa rin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing may luma at bagong address sa harap at likod. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つの宛先が残る状態では送付先が分かりにくくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Malabo ang pagpapadalhan kapag dalawa ang natira.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では新しい封筒に移します。中身を入れ直してから、今回の料金を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新封筒へ移し今回の料金確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ililipat ko sa bagong sobre. Gusto kong malaman ang bayad matapos ibalik ang laman.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Lumipat sa bagong sobre at hilingin ang bayad ngayon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。新しい封筒の大きさと重さを確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sige. Susuriin ang laki at bigat ng bago at ipaliliwanag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。古い料金表示を切り取って貼らず、新しい封筒で必要な料金を払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い印刷を移さず新しい料金を支払うと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Hindi gugupitin at ididikit ang lumang marka; magbabayad ng kailangan sa bagong sobre.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang hindi ililipat ang lumang limbag at babayaran ang bago. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。準備ができましたら、新しい封筒をこちらへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Oo. Dalhin ang bagong sobre rito kapag handa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 明細のどこを確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Anong bahagi ng statement ang nais tingnan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相手へ振り込めたかです。ATMから紙が出たので、完了したと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ATMの紙を振込完了の証拠と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kung naipadala sa tatanggap. May papel na lumabas sa ATM kaya akala ko tapos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na papel ng ATM ang inakalang patunay ng transfer. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この紙には「残高照会」とあります。振込の受付記録とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nakasulat 'Balance inquiry'. Iba sa tala ng pagtanggap ng transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 残高を見たあと振込ボタンを押したつもりですが、この紙だけでは証明にならないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残高照会と振込記録を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko pinindot ang transfer matapos balance, pero hindi patunay ang papel lang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang balance inquiry sa rekord ng transfer. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。口座の取引状況を確認する手順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Oo. Ipapaliwanag ang pagtingin sa transaksiyon ng account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。確認前に同じ振込をもう一度しないよう、先に状況を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重複振込を避け先に取引確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakiusap. Alamin ko muna para hindi ulitin ang parehong transfer bago makumpirma.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Unahin ang pagsusuri para maiwasan dobleng transfer. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。振込先と予定の金額もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sige. May tatanggap at planong halaga?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この案内です。相手には、まだ振込完了を確認できていないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予定の振込情報を示し相手には未確認と連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Itong gabay. Sasabihin sa tatanggap na hindi pa kumpirmadong tapos ang transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang planong transfer at sabihing hindi pa kumpirmado. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。取引の照会には本人確認が必要です。担当者がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo. Kailangan ng ID sa pagtatanong ng transaksiyon. Gagabayan ng kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。明細の種類と口座の記録を確かめてから、追加操作と相手への連絡を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 照会後に操作と完了連絡を判断すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Titingnan ang uri ng statement at account record bago piliin ang susunod na kilos at pakikipag-ugnayan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasya sa kilos at pabatid ng pagkumpleto matapos magtanong. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。重複操作は保留し、取引確認の担当者へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Itigil muna ang dobleng kilos at dadalhin sa kawani ng transaksiyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お支払いにこちらの商品券をご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Gagamit ng gift voucher na ito sa bayad?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。似た名前の店で使えたので、ここでも使えると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た店で使えた商品券を利用したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Nagamit sa kahawig na pangalan ng tindahan, kaya akala ko dito rin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nais gamitin ang voucher sa kahawig na tindahan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当店で扱う商品券か確認します。裏面の利用店案内は見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Susuriin kung tinatanggap namin. Nabasa ang kalahok na tindahan sa likod?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。店名の一文字が違いました。同じ会社かどうかも分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店名の違いと系列不明を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa. Isang karakter ang iba sa pangalan. Hindi rin alam kung iisang kompanya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Aminin ang pagkakaiba ng pangalan at hindi alam na kaugnayan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では当店は対象店ではありません。別の支払い方法を選べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hindi kami kalahok sa sitwasyong ito. Maaari ibang bayad?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 現金で払えます。ただ、今あるお金で足りるか、合計をもう一度教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 利用不可を受け現金支払いの合計を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Makababayad ng cash. Pero sabihin ulit ang kabuuan para malaman kung sapat ang hawak.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Kapag hindi tinanggap, kumpirmahin ang total para sa cash. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 合計は千八百円です。お持ちの現金をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: 1,800 yen ang total. Tingnan ang pera ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二千円あります。買う物は変えずに現金で払い、商品券は持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 商品を変えず現金で支払うと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: May 2,000. Hindi papalitan ang binili, cash ang bayad at iuuwi ang voucher.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang hindi baguhin ang produkto at cash ang bayad. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。商品券の有効期限や使える店は、発行元の案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sige. Tingnan ang tagubilin ng naglabas para sa bisa at magagamit na tindahan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。名前が似ているだけで判断せず、次は利用店の一覧を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次回は発行元の利用店一覧を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Oo. Hindi lang kahawig na pangalan; titingnan ang listahan sa susunod.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing titingnan ang listahan ng tagapaglabas sa susunod. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。今回は現金二千円をお預かりして会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Tatanggap kami ng 2,000 yen cash para rito.
